title: Sphinx Artist vs Dragon
description: A surreal fantasy scene on a broken stone cliff features a white sphinx with glasses sitting at a wooden desk, drawing motorcycles in a sketchbook with a pencil. In the background, a blue armored knight with glowing energy swords battles a large black dragon breathing fire, while two motorcyclists speed along the road below and a red devil and bandaged mummy stand nearby watching.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene set on crumbling ancient stone ruins under a swirling purple and blue cosmic sky, a white hairless sphinx wearing round glasses sits at an ornate wooden desk on a checkered floor, intently drawing motorcycles and notes in a large sketchbook with a pencil, in the background a blue armored knight with glowing blue energy blades stands on a cliff edge facing a massive black dragon with red wings breathing orange fire, two motorcyclists with headlights ride on the road below, a red devil and a bandaged mummy stand on the right observing, epic composition, highly detailed digital art
